text:
Alex: Tagging the postmortem closure sprint for the authz token incidents. This thread is for owners + ETAs. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/2876543210

Nina: Ack. I'll take the rotation orchestration (Vault -> k8s secret sync, staged keys). Planning a phased rollout; ETA: 6 business days. Will add rollback steps and a smoke test.

Rob: I'll handle audit logging fixes: add HMAC signing, a re-ingest gap checker, and tighten retention policies for critical streams. ETA: 8 days.

sec-audit-bot: Created ticket INC-3921 and linked to JIRA: https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/INC-3921 (remediation tracking). Please add ETA and PR links.

ops-team: Low-traffic windows available: Thu 03:00 UTC and Sun 05:00 UTC. Ops can reserve Thu 03:00 if you confirm 24h prior and will enable a temporary traffic-shed option.

Nina: Thu 03:00 UTC confirmed. I'll stage a dry-run in staging 48h before and post the playbook.

Alex: We saw a ~21-day recurrence across teams. Proposal: add a regression-loopback CI job that runs token-validation E2E and a token-validation SLO (>=99.95%). Who can own the CI job?

Rob: I'll add the CI E2E job and a Grafana dashboard. Drafting a Prometheus alert: token_validation_error_rate > 0.3% over 5m -> route to security-oncall. Opening PR shortly.

Alex: Quick recap of owners & timelines:
- Nina: rotation orchestration + playbook (6 business days; Thu 03:00 UTC window)
- Rob: audit logging fixes + CI job + alert (8 days)
- Alex: weekly closure sync until items closed; will update INC-3921.

Alex: Ping here as you start work or hit blockers. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
